stages.name: 왕궁의 아침
stages.reason: 계절의 별이 흩어져 왕궁 문이 잠겼어요. 친구를 도울 여행 준비가 필요해요.
stages.resolved: 왕궁 문이 열렸어요. 준비한 옷으로 여행을 시작해요.

stages.name: 비 오는 정원
stages.reason: 소나기에 토끼가 젖고 있어요. 비옷과 장화, 우산을 준비해 함께 걸어요.
stages.resolved: 토끼가 우산 아래로 들어오고 정원의 첫 별이 빛나요.

stages.name: 눈의 성
stages.reason: 성에 갑자기 눈이 내려 요정의 날개가 차가워졌어요. 따뜻한 준비를 해 온기를 나눠요.
stages.resolved: 요정이 다시 날고 눈꽃 별을 돌려줘요.

stages.name: 마법의 숲
stages.reason: 숲의 이정표가 뒤섞였어요. 탐험 옷을 입고 친구와 길을 찾아요.

stages.name: 바닷가 축제
stages.reason: 햇빛이 밝고 모래가 뜨거워요. 해변에 어울리는 옷과 신발을 준비해 게를 만나러 가요.
stages.resolved: 모래성을 함께 만들고 바다의 별을 찾아요.

stages.name: 왕국의 무도회
stages.reason: 다섯 장소에서 되찾은 별이 모였어요. 친구들이 준비한 무대에 함께 올라요.
stages.resolved: 정답 점수 대신 도와준 친구들의 감사, 런웨이, 포토타임으로 축하해요.

intro: Good morning, Joy! The weather is mixed up! Let’s get ready to help our friends.
안녕, 조이! 왕국의 날씨가 뒤섞였어. 친구들을 도우러 갈 준비를 하자!
hint: Let’s try again. Look at the picture!
complete: You did it! We are ready to help our friends. Here is your new dress!
준비 완료! 선물로 장미 드레스를 받았어요!
garden-intro: Oh! It’s raining! Our rabbit friend needs help. Let’s get ready!
비가 와요! 토끼 친구를 도울 준비를 해요.
garden-end: Hooray! The rabbit is dry! You earned an umbrella and boots.
토끼가 비를 피했어요! 우산과 장화를 받았어요.
snow-intro: Brr! The castle is frozen. Let’s bring warmth to our fairy friend.
성이 꽁꽁 얼었어요. 요정 친구에게 온기를 나눠줘요.
coat: It’s cold. Put on your coat.
scarf: Keep your neck warm. Wear your scarf.
gloves: Keep your hands warm. Put on your gloves.
snow-end: Wonderful! The fairy can fly again. These winter clothes are yours!
요정이 다시 날아요! 겨울 의상을 받았어요.
forest-intro: Our fox friend is lost in the forest. Let’s follow the glowing path.
여우가 길을 잃었어요. 빛나는 숲길을 따라가요.
hat: We are exploring the forest. Find your hat.
pants: The path has prickly plants. Wear your pants.
sneakers: We will walk a long way. Put on your sneakers.
오래 걸을 수 있도록 운동화를 신어요.
forest-end: You found the way home! The fox says thank you. Keep your explorer outfit!
여우가 집을 찾았어요! 탐험 의상을 받았어요.
beach-intro: The sunshine is back! Help the sea turtle get ready for the festival.
swim-sandals: Wear your swimsuit and put on your sandals.
수영복을 입고 샌들도 신겨주세요. 두 가지를 모두 준비해요.
sunglasses: It’s sunny at the beach. Wear your sunglasses, too.
beach-end: The festival is ready! Here are your summer clothes. Let’s go to the royal ball!
축제 준비 완료! 여름 의상을 받고 무도회로 가요.
ball-intro: Our friends are waiting at the royal ball. Let’s bring back the kingdom’s magic!
친구들이 무도회에서 기다려요. 왕국의 마법을 되찾아요!
gown: Choose a beautiful gown for the royal ball.
necklace: Add your necklace. It sparkles like the stars!
ball-crown: Put on your crown. Now we are ready!
ending: You did it, Joy! The seasons are back! All our friends say thank you. This special crown is for you. Let’s celebrate!
조이 덕분에 계절이 돌아왔어요! 특별 왕관을 받고 모두 함께 축하해요!
both: Lovely! Now find the other item in the picture.
잘했어요! 그림에 있는 다른 옷도 찾아주세요.
story-palace-door-intro: Good morning! Our friends need help. Let’s get ready.
좋은 아침이에요! 친구들이 도움이 필요해요. 함께 준비해요.
story-palace-door-end: The door is open! Let’s find our friends.
왕궁 문이 열렸어요. 준비한 옷으로 여행을 시작해요.
story-palace-door-reason-1: Your dress is ready for an adventure.
드레스를 입고 모험에 나설 준비가 됐어요.
story-palace-door-reason-3: You are ready to help the kingdom.
story-palace-picnic-intro: A letter is hiding in the garden. Let’s look for it.
정원에 편지가 숨어 있어요. 함께 찾아봐요.
story-palace-picnic-end: Here is the letter! The picnic can begin.
옷을 준비해 정원에 나서자 토끼가 초대장을 찾아요.
story-palace-picnic-reason-2: We can walk along the garden path.
story-palace-jian-intro: Jian made a sunny dress for you. Let’s try it on.
지안이 햇살 같은 드레스를 만들었어요. 입어볼까요?
story-palace-jian-end: You made it, Jian! Let’s take a picture.
“지안이가 디자인했어요” 크레딧과 함께 창작을 축하하는 포토타임으로 마무리해요.
story-palace-jian-reason-3: Thank you for your lovely design, Jian!
story-garden-rabbit-intro: It's raining. The little rabbit is wet.
비가 와요. 작은 토끼가 비에 젖었어요.
story-garden-rabbit-end: Come under the umbrella, little rabbit!
토끼가 우산 아래로 들어오고 정원의 첫 별이 빛나요.
story-garden-rabbit-reason-2: Your boots keep your feet dry.
story-garden-rabbit-reason-3: 우산을 친구와 나눠 쓸 수 있어요.
story-garden-puddle-intro: There is a big puddle. The letter must stay dry.
커다란 물웅덩이가 있어요. 편지를 젖지 않게 해야 해요.
story-garden-puddle-end: The letter is dry. Thank you for helping!
편지를 무사히 전해 주고 무지개가 떠요.
story-garden-puddle-step-2: Boots on! Now your feet are ready.
story-garden-puddle-reason-2: Boots help us walk through the rain.
장화를 신고 빗속을 걸어갈 수 있어요.
story-garden-puddle-reason-3: The letter can stay dry, too.
story-garden-seedling-intro: The small plant needs a little shelter. Let’s help.
작은 새싹에게 비를 피할 곳이 필요해요. 함께 도와줘요.
story-garden-seedling-end: The little plant is standing tall again!
새싹이 다시 고개를 들고 고슴도치가 고마워해요.
story-garden-seedling-reason-2: You can help while staying dry.
몸을 젖지 않게 하고 친구를 도울 수 있어요.
story-garden-seedling-reason-3: A little shelter makes a big difference.
story-snow-fairy-intro: Brr! It's cold. The fairy needs a warm friend.
으, 추워요! 요정에게 따뜻한 친구가 필요해요.
story-snow-fairy-end: Warm hands, warm hearts! The fairy can fly.
요정이 다시 날고 눈꽃 별을 돌려줘요.
story-snow-fairy-reason-1: Your coat keeps your body warm.
story-snow-fairy-step-2: Wrap your scarf around your neck.
story-snow-fairy-reason-2: A scarf feels soft and warm.
story-snow-lantern-intro: The lantern is dark. Let’s bring back its warm light.
story-snow-lantern-end: Look! The lantern is glowing again.
등불이 켜져 성의 친구들이 길을 찾을 수 있어요.
story-snow-lantern-reason-1: A warm coat is good for a snowy day.
눈 오는 날에는 따뜻한 코트가 좋아요.
story-snow-lantern-reason-2: They keep your fingers together and warm.
벙어리장갑이 손가락을 함께 감싸 따뜻하게 해줘요.
story-snow-lantern-reason-3: Now we are ready for the snow.
이제 눈 속으로 나갈 준비가 됐어요.
story-snow-parade-intro: The parade has stopped. Our friends feel cold.
story-snow-parade-end: Wave hello! The happy parade is moving.
따뜻하게 준비한 주인공의 응원으로 퍼레이드가 다시 시작돼요.
story-snow-parade-reason-1: It wraps softly around your neck.
story-snow-parade-reason-2: We dress warmly before we go.
story-snow-parade-step-3: Keep your hands warm with mittens.
story-snow-parade-reason-3: Now we can wave to our friends.
이제 친구들에게 손을 흔들 수 있어요.
story-forest-fox-intro: The fox is lost. Let’s follow the forest path.
여우가 길을 잃었어요. 숲길을 함께 따라가요.
story-forest-fox-end: This is the way home. Thank you, explorer!
story-forest-fox-reason-1: Your hat is ready for the journey.
story-forest-fox-reason-2: We can move along the forest path.
story-forest-bridge-intro: A little bridge is ahead. Let’s get ready to walk.
앞에 작은 다리가 있어요. 걸어갈 준비를 해요.
story-forest-bridge-end: We made it together. What a lovely view!
친구와 함께 다리를 건너 숲의 별을 발견해요.
story-forest-bridge-reason-2: We are going on a forest adventure.
story-forest-birds-intro: Can you hear a little bird? Let’s find our friend.
작은 새의 노래가 들리나요? 친구를 함께 찾아봐요.
story-forest-birds-end: Tweet, tweet! The forest has its song again.
새가 노래를 되찾고 친구들이 함께 따라 불러요.
story-forest-birds-reason-1: Our outfit is ready for the forest.
story-forest-birds-reason-3: We are ready to look and listen.
이제 살펴보고 귀 기울일 준비가 됐어요.
story-beach-crab-intro: The sun is bright. The crab needs our help.
햇살이 눈부셔요. 게 친구에게 도움이 필요해요.
story-beach-crab-end: The crab is smiling. Let’s build a sandcastle!
모래성을 함께 만들고 바다의 별을 찾아요.
story-beach-crab-reason-2: Your feet are ready for the beach.
story-beach-crab-reason-3: They help in the bright sunshine.
story-beach-shell-intro: The shells are shining. Let’s help the turtle.
story-beach-shell-end: One shell, two shells! The turtle is home.
조개를 전해 주며 수를 세는 짧은 선택 대사를 즐겨요. 수 세기는 통과 조건이 아니에요.
story-beach-shell-reason-1: We wear shoes on the hot sand.
story-beach-shell-reason-2: Now the bright light feels softer.
story-beach-shell-reason-3: We are dressed for a sunny day.
story-beach-pair-intro: An invitation is here! Let’s get ready for the sea festival.
초대장이 도착했어요! 바다 축제에 갈 준비를 해요.
story-beach-pair-end: Both are on! Let’s go to the festival.
복합 지시는 두 아이템이 모두 착용되어야 통과하며, 한 개만 입었을 때 남은 아이템을 명확히 알려줘요.
story-beach-pair-step-1: Put on your beach outfit and sandals.
story-beach-pair-reason-1: Two things help us get ready. Take your time.
두 가지를 준비해요. 천천히 해도 괜찮아요.
story-beach-pair-reason-2: Now your sunny look is ready.
story-ball-stars-intro: All our friends are here. Let’s celebrate together!
story-ball-stars-end: You did it! Let’s walk, wave, and take a picture.
정답 점수 대신 도와준 친구들의 감사, 런웨이, 포토타임으로 축하해요.
story-ball-stars-reason-1: The stars sparkle on your dress.
story-ball-stars-reason-3: You helped our kingdom shine again.
story-ball-jian-intro: Jian's design is on the runway today. Let’s make it shine.
오늘은 지안의 디자인이 무대에 올라요. 함께 빛내줘요.
story-ball-jian-end: Designed by Jian. Worn with joy!
저장 사진과 무대에 지안의 디자인 크레딧을 유지하고 자유 꾸미기를 열어요.
story-ball-jian-reason-1: A young designer made these lovely flowers.
어린 디자이너가 이 예쁜 꽃을 만들었어요.
story-ball-jian-reason-2: Blue and yellow look lovely together.
story-ball-jian-reason-3: A little sparkle finishes your look.
story-ball-friends-intro: Different looks, wonderful friends. Everyone can shine.
서로 다른 모습의 멋진 친구들! 모두 빛날 수 있어요.
story-ball-friends-end: Shine in your own way. Thank you for helping!
캐릭터를 바꿔도 같은 학습 기회와 보상을 주고, 이후 자유 무대에서는 모든 착장을 허용해요.
story-ball-friends-reason-1: Choose a look that makes you smile.
story-ball-friends-reason-2: Your shoes are ready for the runway.
story-ball-friends-reason-3: We all belong on this happy stage.
